scope: Independent complete C-STMP candidate; first 200 epochs from original random trunk, classifier 100 epochs from random initialization; same Gaussian likelihood rule in all modules; old full SNR remains paused.
approximations: Independent Gaussian incoming messages; 16x16 input-column covariance shared across antenna/output coordinates.
Finite four-direction conditional covariance, with orthogonal complex probes; relative posterior eigenvalue projection inside each iteration.
Covariance shapes from independent partial-DFT operators and Gaussian message parameters; finite covariance pool is not the exact receiver residual distribution.
differences: One shared precision-conditioned likelihood and preconditioned representation, replacing vI-only runtime/classifier conditions.
Pilot-derived column precision shapes and expanded power range; original clean data, first DSM, Adam, EMA, learning-rate schedule and 200/100 epochs retained.
Full column covariance feedback and Gaussian natural-parameter damping; frozen threshold and damping weight retained.
Fused Adam and pinned background prefetch for training throughput; float32 retained.
